answer:
Done. `addToCart` in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g2_add_voucher/source/codex/3/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) now takes an optional trailing `promoCode` parameter, and when it's provided it's sent as the `voucher` field in the add/update cart body — omitted entirely when no code is given. The diff is limited to the signature plus the three guarded lines; I preserved the file's CRLF line endings, and a syntax check passes.

- `~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/.../shoppingcart/BasketLineInput.java` — the backend's cart-item request model, which defines the `voucher` field
- `~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/.../api/v1/shoppingCart/BasketEndpoint.java` — confirmed `BasketLineInput` is the request body for the POST/PUT cart endpoints those calls hit
